Transparent arithmetic and temperature-order derivations
sources.details: Four confidences sum to 3, so mean=3/4=.75; correctness=2/4=.5. With only the populated high box, ECE=(4/4)|.5-.75|=.25. Adding (.25,correct=1): ECE=(1/5)|1-.25|+(4/5)|.5-.75|=.15+.20=.35. -ln(.8)=.2231435513 and -ln(.2)=1.6094379124. Unhalved Brier for p=(.8,.2), y=(0,1) is .8^2+(.2-1)^2=1.28. For positive T, sign((z_i-z_j)/T)=sign(z_i-z_j), preserving the maximum and ties; p_max(T)=1/(sum_j exp((z_j-z_max)/T)), so increasing T moves probability mass toward uniform and does not increase p_max. Choice of T depends on losses and margins, not solely majority correctness. For a chosen binning, ECE=sum_b |sum_{i in b}(correct_i-confidence_i)|/N; the absolute aggregate mean gap is |sum_i(correct_i-confidence_i)|/N <= ECE by triangle inequality, so boxwise errors need not equal a distance between global means. Figure coordinates: (130+350*.75,567-350*.5)=(392.5,392). Audio bars: 560*.8796=492.576 and 560*.9273=519.288; shared accuracy marker x=32+560*(11/14)=472. Rounded aggregate gap .8796-.7857=.0939.
